summary: The registrant filed a Form 6-K on 1 July 2026 to disclose total voting rights and capital under UK Disclosure and Transparency Rule 5.6.1. It states issued share capital of 154,405,753 ordinary shares, 5,431,782 shares in treasury, and total voting rights of 148,973,971. The announcement notes purchases for cancellation made since 1 June 2026 under shareholder authority granted on 7 May 2026. This is a routine regulatory disclosure with no M&A, activist, restructuring, or other special situation component.
